bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=debug-ai --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=debug-ai)"
test -n "$cid"
docker exec "$cid" node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),base="/app/runtime/";for(const n of ["teaching-parallel-20261128-1630","teaching-parallel-20261128-1759"]){const s=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(base+n+"/status.json"));const rows=s.lessons.map(x=>{const p=base+n+"/"+x.id+".json";const t=fs.existsSync(p)?JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p)).turns[0]:null;return {topic:x.topic,status:x.status,phase:x.phase,error:x.error,verdict:x.verdict,stages:(t?.teaching?.stages||[]).map(y=>({phase:y.phase,model:y.model,state:y.state,error:y.error,invalid_field:y.invalid_field,invalid_kind:y.invalid_kind,output:y.output, cost:y.cost}))};});console.log(JSON.stringify({id:n,status:s.status,rows,cost:s.cost_usd,updated_at:s.updated_at}));}'
